_comments: The Contract Type form's SECTIONS — each category's icon and the sentence under its header.
CodeGen groups the generated form by EntityField.Category; these two settings are what give
each group a name-level icon and description.
THIS IS METADATA AND MUST NEVER BE WRITTEN AS SQL IN A MIGRATION.
An earlier draft of V202609140100 hand-merged the same JSON with two UPDATE statements. A
setting written that way is invisible to `mj sync`, so it drifts from the JSON the release-time
Metadata_Sync migration is generated from, and the next real push silently contradicts it.
The VALUE IS A JSON OBJECT, not a string containing JSON. `mj sync` stringifies an object for a
string column on its own, and writing the escaped form by hand is how a quoting mistake becomes
Both rows carry the IDs the baseline seeded (B202608040001 lines 8601 and 8606), so this file
UPDATES them rather than inserting a second copy. It therefore has to carry EVERY category, not
just the new one: the value is replaced wholesale, and listing only 'Default Contract Terms'
would strip the three the baseline shipped — which is exactly the defect CodeGen's own emitted
Dev loop after editing this file: `mj migrate` -> `mj sync push --dir metadata` -> `mj codegen`.
Skipping the push leaves the setting unapplied and CodeGen regenerates the form without it.

Contract Type Details.description: Basic identification and status information for the contract type

Configuration Rules.description: Business logic and constraints governing contract behavior and placement

Default Contract Terms.description: Default renewal terms copied onto a new contract of this type. A starting point the user may change, not a rule.

_comments: The legacy icons-only setting, kept in step with the one above because older form chrome still
reads it. Same rules: object value, every category listed, baseline's own ID.
